+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;

+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;

+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{

+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

**Revising target data mapping strategy**

I'll switch from manual enter/exit helpers to wrapping each run_event’s kernel loops inside a single `#pragma omp target data` block that maps all needed arrays upfront, including sample arrays with `map(alloc:)`. This keeps data mapped for the entire block, simplifies pointer management, and should fix illegal address errors while retaining correctness despite some added host-device copies. I’ll remove the enter/exit helpers, update mapping clauses carefully, and adjust timing measurements around this new target data region.

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static void enter_simulation_data(const Inputs* in, SimulationData* GSD)
+{
+        if (GSD->num_nucs && GSD->length_num_nucs > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->num_nucs[0:GSD->length_num_nucs])
+        }
+        if (GSD->concs && GSD->length_concs > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->concs[0:GSD->length_concs])
+        }
+        if (GSD->mats && GSD->length_mats > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->mats[0:GSD->length_mats])
+        }
+        if (GSD->unionized_energy_array && GSD->length_unionized_energy_array > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->unionized_energy_array[0:GSD->length_unionized_energy_array])
+        }
+        if (GSD->index_grid && GSD->length_index_grid > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->index_grid[0:GSD->length_index_grid])
+        }
+        if (GSD->nuclide_grid && GSD->length_nuclide_grid > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(to: GSD->nuclide_grid[0:GSD->length_nuclide_grid])
+        }
+        if (GSD->verification && in->lookups > 0) {
+#pragma omp target enter data map(alloc: GSD->verification[0:in->lookups])
+        }
+}
+
+static void exit_simulation_data(const Inputs* in, SimulationData* GSD)
+{
+        if (GSD->verification && in->lookups > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(from: GSD->verification[0:in->lookups])
+        }
+        if (GSD->num_nucs && GSD->length_num_nucs > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->num_nucs[0:GSD->length_num_nucs])
+        }
+        if (GSD->concs && GSD->length_concs > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->concs[0:GSD->length_concs])
+        }
+        if (GSD->mats && GSD->length_mats > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->mats[0:GSD->length_mats])
+        }
+        if (GSD->unionized_energy_array && GSD->length_unionized_energy_array > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->unionized_energy_array[0:GSD->length_unionized_energy_array])
+        }
+        if (GSD->index_grid && GSD->length_index_grid > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->index_grid[0:GSD->length_index_grid])
+        }
+        if (GSD->nuclide_grid && GSD->length_nuclide_grid > 0) {
+#pragma omp target exit data map(release: GSD->nuclide_grid[0:GSD->length_nuclide_grid])
+        }
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}

+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}


thinking
**Refactoring optimization functions for target data**

I'm removing all `enter`/`exit` and separate `target enter/exit` calls around sample arrays, instead wrapping key kernels inside a single `#pragma omp target data` block that maps all needed static arrays and sample buffers. For optimizations 1-3, no host-device updates are needed, so no explicit `target update` calls. For 4-6, I'll keep updates for host operations within the target data block. I'll apply this pattern first by fully rewriting `run_event_based_simulation_optimization_1`.

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}

+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}

+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

        double LCG_random_double(uint64_t * seed)
        {

                const uint64_t m = 9223372036854775808ULL;
                const uint64_t a = 2806196910506780709ULL;
                const uint64_t c = 1ULL;
                *seed = (a * (*seed) + c) % m;
                return (double) (*seed) / (double) m;
        }

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation(Inputs in, SimulationData SD, int mype, Profile* profile)
+{
+        switch (in.kernel_id)
+        {
+                case 0:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_baseline(in, SD, mype, profile);
+                case 1:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_1(in, SD, mype);
+                case 2:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(in, SD, mype);
+                case 3:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_3(in, SD, mype);
+                case 4:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_4(in, SD, mype);
+                case 5:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_5(in, SD, mype);
+                case 6:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_6(in, SD, mype);
+                default:
+                        fprintf(stderr, "Error: unsupported kernel_id %d for OpenMP code.\n", in.kernel_id);
+                        exit(1);
+        }
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)

+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];

+

+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;

+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(Inputs in, SimulationData GSD, int mype);

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation_optimization_6(Inputs in, SimulationData GSD, int mype);
+
+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation(Inputs in, SimulationData SD, int mype, Profile* profile)
+{
+        switch (in.kernel_id)
+        {
+                case 0:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_baseline(in, SD, mype, profile);
+                case 1:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_1(in, SD, mype);
+                case 2:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(in, SD, mype);
+                case 3:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_3(in, SD, mype);
+                case 4:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_4(in, SD, mype);
+                case 5:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_5(in, SD, mype);
+                case 6:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_6(in, SD, mype);
+                default:
+                        fprintf(stderr, "Error: unsupported kernel_id %d for OpenMP code.\n", in.kernel_id);
+                        exit(1);
+        }
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(Inputs in, SimulationData GSD, int mype);

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation(Inputs in, SimulationData SD, int mype, Profile* profile)
+{
+        switch (in.kernel_id)
+        {
+                case 0:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_baseline(in, SD, mype, profile);
+                case 1:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_1(in, SD, mype);
+                case 2:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(in, SD, mype);
+                case 3:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_3(in, SD, mype);
+                case 4:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_4(in, SD, mype);
+                case 5:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_5(in, SD, mype);
+                case 6:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_6(in, SD, mype);
+                default:
+                        fprintf(stderr, "Error: unsupported kernel_id %d for OpenMP code.\n", in.kernel_id);
+                        exit(1);
+        }
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}
+
+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+unsigned long long run_event_based_simulation(Inputs in, SimulationData SD, int mype, Profile* profile)
+{
+        switch (in.kernel_id)
+        {
+                case 0:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_baseline(in, SD, mype, profile);
+                case 1:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_1(in, SD, mype);
+                case 2:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_2(in, SD, mype);
+                case 3:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_3(in, SD, mype);
+                case 4:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_4(in, SD, mype);
+                case 5:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_5(in, SD, mype);
+                case 6:
+                        return run_event_based_simulation_optimization_6(in, SD, mype);
+                default:
+                        fprintf(stderr, "Error: unsupported kernel_id %d for OpenMP code.\n", in.kernel_id);
+                        exit(1);
+        }
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}

+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;

+typedef struct { int key; double value; } KeyValueIntDouble;
+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
+}
+
+static int host_count(const int* arr, int n, int value)
+{
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+                if (arr[i] == value)
+                        count++;
+        return count;
+}

+typedef struct { double key; int value; } KeyValueDoubleInt;
+
+static void sort_key_value_int_double(int* keys, double* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueIntDouble* pairs = (KeyValueIntDouble*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueIntDouble), compare_int_double);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static void sort_key_value_double_int(double* keys, int* values, int n)
+{
+        KeyValueDoubleInt* pairs = (KeyValueDoubleInt*) malloc(n * sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt));
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                pairs[i].key = keys[i];
+                pairs[i].value = values[i];
+        }
+
+        qsort(pairs, n, sizeof(KeyValueDoubleInt), compare_double_int);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        {
+                keys[i] = pairs[i].key;
+                values[i] = pairs[i].value;
+        }
+
+        free(pairs);
+}
+
+static int host_partition_fuel(int* mats, double* energies, int n)
+{
+        int left = 0;
+        int right = n - 1;
+        while (left <= right)
+        {
+                while (left <= right && mats[left] == 0)
+                        left++;
+                while (left <= right && mats[right] != 0)
+                        right--;
+                if (left < right)
+                {
+                        int tmp_mat = mats[left];
+                        mats[left] = mats[right];
+                        mats[right] = tmp_mat;
+
+                        double tmp_energy = energies[left];
+                        energies[left] = energies[right];
+                        energies[right] = tmp_energy;
+
+                        left++;
+                        right--;
+                }
+        }
+        return left;
+}
+
+static int compare_int_double(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* lhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) a;
+        const KeyValueIntDouble* rhs = (const KeyValueIntDouble*) b;
+        return lhs->key - rhs->key;
+}
+
+static int compare_double_int(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* lhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) a;
+        const KeyValueDoubleInt* rhs = (const KeyValueDoubleInt*) b;
+        if (lhs->key < rhs->key)
+                return -1;
+        if (lhs->key > rhs->key)
+                return 1;
+        return 0;
+}

+static unsigned long long host_reduce_verification(const unsigned long* verification, int lookups)
+{
+        unsigned long long sum = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < lookups; i++)
+                sum += verification[i];
+        return sum;
